tools.name: get_workflow_guide
tools.description: Returns required inputs, ordered steps, example requests and review criteria for eight supported Magic Hour workflows. Use when planning a generation, not to run one. Requires authentication but does not check account eligibility or spend credits.

tools.name: upload_chatgpt_image
tools.description: Uploads a PNG, JPEG or WebP image attached in ChatGPT to the connected Magic Hour account. Use this for native ChatGPT photo attachments instead of asking the chat's file runtime to PUT bytes to get_upload_urls. Pass the returned file_path to the existing image or video generation tool. Accepts one

tools.name: upload_chatgpt_media
tools.description: Uploads one native ChatGPT attachment to the connected Magic Hour account: PNG/JPEG/WebP images, MP4/MOV/WebM video, or MP3/WAV/M4A/FLAC/Ogg/WebM audio, up to 20 MiB. Set media_type to the attachment's actual kind, not the requested output: image, video or audio. For multiple references, call separa

tools.name: ping
tools.description: Checks that the Magic Hour server is reachable. Use for connectivity troubleshooting; it does not validate API credentials or account access. Makes no media or project changes.

tools.name: wait_for_video_project
tools.description: Polls a video project until it completes, errors, is canceled or times out. Use with the id returned by a video create tool. Read-only; returns download URLs when complete. After a timeout, resume with the same id rather than creating another generation. Use signed download URLs exactly as returned.

tools.name: wait_for_image_project
tools.description: Polls an image project until it completes, errors, is canceled or times out. Use with the id returned by an image create tool. Read-only; returns the project and download URLs, with optional inline image previews sharing an 8 MiB total limit. After a timeout, resume with the same id rather than crea

tools.name: wait_for_audio_project
tools.description: Polls an audio project until it completes, errors, is canceled or times out. Use with the id returned by an audio create tool. Read-only; returns the project and download URLs, with optional inline audio previews sharing an 8 MiB total limit. After a timeout, resume with the same id rather than crea

tools.name: fetch_image_download
tools.description: Fetch a completed project's image as inline MCP image content for compatible clients. Use the exact signed download URL, including query parameters. Requires HTTPS at the configured Magic Hour media host. Read-only; limited to 8 MiB, or a smaller requested max_bytes. Use the signed URL directly for

tools.name: fetch_audio_download
tools.description: Fetch a completed project's audio as inline MCP audio content for compatible clients. Use the exact signed download URL, including query parameters. Requires HTTPS at the configured Magic Hour media host. Read-only; limited to 8 MiB, or a smaller requested max_bytes. Use the signed URL directly for

tools.name: fetch_video_download
tools.description: Fetch a completed project's video as an embedded MCP binary resource for compatible clients. Use the exact signed download URL, including query parameters. Requires HTTPS at the configured Magic Hour media host. Read-only; limited to 8 MiB, or a smaller requested max_bytes. Use the signed URL direct

tools.name: get_account_info
tools.description: Returns credit balance and subscription details for the connected account. Use to inspect account information before choosing generation settings. Use tier, not the subscription name or credit balance, for plan access. Read-only; this is not a request-specific cost quote or model-eligibility check.

tools.name: list_saved_items
tools.description: Lists the account's active saved characters, references, voice recordings, moodboards and brand kits, newest first. Reusable paths are in each item's assets[].file_path; temporary signed URLs support preview/download. Read-only; pass next_cursor as cursor for the next page.

tools.name: voices_list
tools.description: List the voices available for text-to-speech. Use a voice's `id` as `style.voice_name` in the AI Voice Generator API. To fetch the next page, pass the response's next_cursor as cursor.

tools.name: get_upload_urls
tools.description: Creates presigned upload URL and file-path pairs for local media. Use when a generation needs a file the user has locally: upload raw bytes to the returned upload_url, then pass its file_path to the create tool. Does not upload file bytes or start a generation.

tools.name: get_face_detection_results
tools.description: Returns a face-detection job's status and detected faces. Use with the id from detect_faces to inspect progress and choose face mappings before a selected-face swap. Read-only; faces may populate while processing.

tools.name: detect_faces
tools.description: Starts an asynchronous face-detection task for a supplied image or video and returns its id and charge information. Use before a selected-face swap, then retrieve its status and detected faces with get_face_detection_results. Current API documentation describes detection as free; pricing may change.

tools.name: get_video_project
tools.description: Returns a video project's status and, once complete, its download URLs. Use to check progress with the id from a video create tool. Read-only.

tools.name: delete_video_project
tools.description: Deletes the video project and attempts to delete its completed output. Cannot be undone; confirm with the user first.
